title: 20" pillow inserts
text: 20" pillow inserts. These are probably the low end of pillow inserts.  I purchased the 20" and they were all four a bit different in size.. that was difficult when trying to 'square' them in the covers - but I made them work.  They are full - but not overly.  They are white.  They arrived sucked down thin and popped up quickly when released.  They are the on the cheap side - but you usually get what you pay for.  Having said all of that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.

product_metadata.title: Phantoscope 20 x 20 Pillow Inserts, Set of 4 Hypoallergenic 100% Virgin Fiber Square Form Decorative Throw Pillow Inserts, Made in USA Couch Bed Pillows - 20 inches
features: Made in the USA - Phantoscope’s pillow inserts are manufactured right here in California, we use American-made virgin micro-fiber filling and high-quality polyester covers that make our pillows longer-lasting, hypoallergenic, and odorless. Every purchase is a show of support for American manufacturing.

High Filling Capacity - Our throw pillows contain 10% more filling than most pillows on the market, and they are also a half-inch larger. We promise that every throw pillow insert is filled to at least 90%, ensuring that all corners are perfectly fitted.

Soft and Resilient - We utilize our patented filling technology, allowing us to fill our pillow forms with high-grade 7D fiber that provides extra resilience and comfort while remaining elastic. Our couch pillows are guaranteed to maintain their shape and provide adequate support without ever developing hollow areas.

Universal Decorative Pillows - Our square form 20x20 inch pillow inserts come in packs of 4. They can be used to support your back or used as an accent piece to go with your bed, couch, car seats, or chairs in any styles and colors.

Vacuum Shipped & Washable - Our pillow inserts are vacuum compressed and sealed for shipping purposes. Take the inserts out of the bag and gently fluff it with your hands for it to take shape. All our pillows can be hand washed or lightly washed with a mild detergent.
